about:
# Goldwright

**Auction house prices for WoW Forever.**

Goldwright shows what things are really worth on your auction house, and helps you sell them for a fair price:

- **Tooltips:** the market price, the normal price over the last 7 or 30 days, a "good time to buy / sell" hint, and how many sell per day.
- **Sell:** pick a bag item and get a fast, typical or patient price with the reasons spelled out, then post from a queue.
- **My auctions:** see your listings and cancel the ones that were undercut.
- **Scan:** a full auction house scan updates prices for your realm between data updates.
- **Shopping lists:** build lists, import and export them, and buy commodities in two clicks.

Goldwright is free. It never buys, posts or cancels for you: every action is your own click.

## Install

Install it with an add-on manager, which also keeps the price data up to date:

1. In the **CurseForge app** or **WowUp**, choose **WoW Forever**, search for **Goldwright** and click Install. Or open it on [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/goldwright).
2. **Goldwright Data** comes with it. It holds the daily prices for every WoW Forever region, and your add-on manager updates it every day. If it doesn't appear, search for **Goldwright Data** and install it too.
3. Log in and type `/gw` in chat.

> **New.** Goldwright is new and still changes quickly. Questions, bugs and ideas are welcome on the [Goldwright Discord](https://discord.gg/PX22TFh4UZ).

The `Goldwright/` folder in this repository is the add-on exactly as it is released. You don't need to download anything from here to play.

More help, how the prices work and item prices for every realm: **[goldwright.app](https://goldwright.app/)**. Questions? Ask in **#help** on the [Goldwright Discord](https://discord.gg/PX22TFh4UZ).

## Found a bug?

Type `/gw bug` in game, copy the report and paste it into **#bug-reports** on the [Goldwright Discord](https://discord.gg/PX22TFh4UZ). Or [open an issue](https://github.com/goldwrightapp/goldwright-addon/issues/new/choose) here and pick **Bug report**. The form asks for:

- your Goldwright and Goldwright Data versions, and what `/gw status` prints (region, ruleset, faction, data pack)
- where it happened (auction house, tooltip, sell panel, ...) and the steps to get there
- a screenshot, and the Lua error text if there is one

Ideas are welcome too: post them in **#ideas** on Discord, or pick **Feature request** here.

## Support Goldwright

Goldwright is free and funded by tips. If it saves you gold, you can [leave a tip on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/goldwrightapp) or see the [server bill on the website](https://goldwright.app/support). Supporting unlocks nothing: everyone gets the same prices.

Contact: hello@goldwright.app

releases.name: Goldwright 0.7.11
releases.notes:
### New
- Look up gear by its full name in the Buy tab ("Medicine Staff of the Tiger"), each variant with its own prices, listings and chart. ([#58](https://github.com/goldwrightapp/goldwright-addon/issues/58))
- Buy gear in the Buy tab and in shopping lists: Buy, then Confirm. ([#61](https://github.com/goldwrightapp/goldwright-addon/issues/61))
- Price history charts for every item with a few days of prices, gear variants included. ([#59](https://github.com/goldwrightapp/goldwright-addon/issues/59))

### Improved
- Gear charts load the first time you open one, so logging in stays as quick as before. ([#59](https://github.com/goldwrightapp/goldwright-addon/issues/59))
- Look up suggestions appear instantly, even after one letter. ([#58](https://github.com/goldwrightapp/goldwright-addon/issues/58))

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed shopping lists and the price watch treating gear variants ("of the Owl", "of the Bear") as one item. ([#60](https://github.com/goldwrightapp/goldwright-addon/issues/60))

---

Goldwright's prices come from **Goldwright Data**, a separate add-on updated every day. The CurseForge app installs it with Goldwright; with any other add-on manager, install [Goldwright Data](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/goldwright-data) too.

releases.name: Goldwright 0.7.10
releases.notes:
### New
- Goldwright now saves full scans started by other add-ons, such as Auctionator, and counts them toward the 15 minutes. ([#51](https://github.com/goldwrightapp/goldwright-addon/issues/51))
- Added a Plan to target on the Level up tab: 75, 150, 225 or 300. ([#31](https://github.com/goldwrightapp/goldwright-addon/issues/31))
- Added stepping through price chart points with the controller's D-pad. ([#19](https://github.com/goldwrightapp/goldwright-addon/issues/19))

### Improved
- Full scans stay smooth on slower computers and the Steam Deck. ([#53](https://github.com/goldwrightapp/goldwright-addon/issues/53))
- A full scan with no answer from the server stops waiting after 60 seconds. ([#51](https://github.com/goldwrightapp/goldwright-addon/issues/51))
- Settings notes name the key you chose for the expanded tooltip. ([#45](https://github.com/goldwrightapp/goldwright-addon/issues/45))

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed auction sale mail sometimes being counted twice in Sales. ([#46](https://github.com/goldwrightapp/goldwright-addon/issues/46))
- Fixed level-up plans being shared between characters with the same first name. ([#47](https://github.com/goldwrightapp/goldwright-addon/issues/47))
- Fixed the Recipes tab showing the previous profession after switching on the Level up tab. ([#50](https://github.com/goldwrightapp/goldwright-addon/issues/50))
- Fixed the controller's D-pad stopping at the last row on screen in Goldwright's lists. ([#57](https://github.com/goldwrightapp/goldwright-addon/issues/57))

releases.name: Goldwright 0.7.8
releases.notes:
### New
- Added the Buy tab: look up any item by name or Alt-click it in your bags, also away from the auction house. ([#37](https://github.com/goldwrightapp/goldwright-addon/issues/37))
- Added today's price compared with the item's usual, its sales, trend, cheapest listings and the other houses' prices to the Buy tab. ([#37](https://github.com/goldwrightapp/goldwright-addon/issues/37))
- Added buying on the Buy tab at the auction house: Under Normal fills the quantity, Buy shows the exact price, Confirm buys. ([#37](https://github.com/goldwrightapp/goldwright-addon/issues/37))
- Added "+ Shopping List" on the Buy tab, with a choice of list. ([#37](https://github.com/goldwrightapp/goldwright-addon/issues/37))
- Added item names to Goldwright Data (English), so the Buy tab can find any item. ([#36](https://github.com/goldwrightapp/goldwright-addon/issues/36))

### Improved
- Alt-clicking an item scrolls the Sell tab's bag list to it. ([#39](https://github.com/goldwrightapp/goldwright-addon/issues/39))
- Button labels use Title Case throughout. ([#41](https://github.com/goldwrightapp/goldwright-addon/issues/41))

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed "Internal auction error" when switching tabs while a price waited for Confirm. ([#40](https://github.com/goldwrightapp/goldwright-addon/issues/40))
